title: Target protected local attachment-byte durability provider

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implemented encrypted attachment-byte vault with validated namespace partitioning, directory-descriptor-relative byte operations, authenticated metadata, bounded ciphertext reads, durable staging/promotion, explicit orphan evidence and a bounded unavailable-inventory failure checkpoint.
surfaces.notes: Local disposable provider only. Pending-work tests can deterministically prove unavailable orphan enumeration refuses; this does not prove physical-device protection, process-kill durability, hosted upload, retention or deletion.

securityRequirements: Bytes and paths are partitioned by validated environment, Principal and Account scope
Ciphertext authentication binds Attachment, parent, scope, digest and byte count
syncRequirements: Raw bytes never enter PowerSync structured upload data or a Sync Stream

migration.rule: Use only synthetic bytes in disposable target fixtures; read no Firebase path, URL or object.
reconciliation: Every accepted queue row resolves to exactly one locally verifiable ciphertext object

acceptance: Encryption, restart, interruption, corruption, scope isolation and storage-pressure cases fail closed without losing prior accepted bytes

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implemented backend-neutral attachment-capture adapter with an encrypted, scope-bound isolated PowerSync database, localOnly queue/binding tables, exact replay protection, non-consuming verified upload candidates and strict path-free pending-work queue-plus-orphan observation.
surfaces.notes: No network uploader, remote completion, reference mutation, discard, eviction, cleanup or shared-runtime composition is authorized. The pending-work implementation distinguishes blocking missing/corrupt evidence from unavailable/interrupted observation; primary ownership remains here.

securityRequirements: Exact environment, Principal, Account, parent, Attachment, byte-count and digest rebinding is denied
syncRequirements: A success receipt is returned only after byte and metadata evidence re-verify; reading a future upload candidate does not mark remote success

migration.rule: Create no Firebase adapter or dual-write path and do not compose into a production runtime.
reconciliation: Exact replay yields one receipt, one queue row and one local object while malformed or missing evidence remains explicit

acceptance: Queue count/order and exact receipt survive adapter/database recreation without false upload or cleanup claims

surfaces.currentBehavior: Implemented deterministic local attachment durability tests for encryption, restart, interruption, wrong-key/corruption, concurrent replay, scope/database binding, SQLCipher leakage, localOnly isolation, path/link defense, non-consuming reads, queue-plus-orphan restart evidence and unavailable inventory/state-write refusal.
surfaces.notes: Disposable local tests cannot promote SPIKE-MED-001 or substitute for physical-device and hosted private-Storage rehearsal. Pending-work queue-plus-orphan and failure-distinction regressions now pass; primary ownership remains here.

surfaces: Attachment local durability provider test suite
securityRequirements: Raw-file, cross-scope and tamper cases are negative assertions rather than success-path assumptions
syncRequirements: Tests prove bytes remain outside ps_crud and local reads cannot manufacture uploaded state

migration.rule: Use temporary directories, synthetic scoped identities and no hosted credentials.
reconciliation: Injected interruption points yield either an exact recoverable accepted record or an explainable non-success orphan

acceptance: Focused and complete target suites plus immutable CI pass on exact synchronized commits
